Subject: SLA/uptime add-on questions for Redwood proposal

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the proposal your team sent last week. We reviewed the uptime add-on and had a few clarifying questions from procurement and engineering before we can move to legal: 

- Can Redwood commit to a 99.99% regional uptime band for our primary region (us-west) rather than a blended SLA?
- Our platform team asked if the S1 response time can be tightened from 30 minutes to 15 minutes.
- For credits, procurement prefers a simpler formula capped at 50% of monthly subscription rather than the tiered slab in the quoted PDF.

We're targeting an executive review next Tuesday (Nov 24). If you can send a short counter with options (price delta for 99.99, response-time uplift, and credit cap), that would help speed things up.

Also, can you confirm whether the add-on is available as a monthly or annual SKU? Our finance prefers annual commit but we may pilot monthly first.

Appreciate it —
Emma

Hi Emma —

Thanks for the quick read. Attached are two files: Redwood_Uptime_AddOn_v3.pdf (detailed options) and Quote_DEAL-54872.xlsx (line-item pricing). Quick summary here so your execs can scan: 

Option A — 99.95% regional uptime (standard)
- S1 response: 30 minutes
- Credit formula: pro-rated token-based, no monthly cap
- Monthly price: $8,250 (add-on)

Option B — 99.99% regional uptime (enhanced)
- S1 response: 30 minutes (we can discuss faster as a paid uplift)
- Credit formula: tiered credits (2%, 5%, 10%) by monthly uptime bands
- Monthly price: $14,900

Optional Uplift: 15-minute S1 response
- Available as an add-on to Option B only; engineering + oncall roster guarantee
- Uplift fee: +25% of the Option B monthly price (includes dedicated rapid-response rotation)

Commit options: monthly or annual. Annual 12-month prepay gives a 10% discount on the base add-on price.

Next steps I recommend: 1) confirm preferred uptime band, 2) indicate whether you want the 15-minute uplift, 3) if you sign an annual commit by Dec 15 we can extend a 12% onboarding credit.

Ben and Monica are copied for the operational details and to line up a short 30-min sync with your SREs. Happy to hop on a call this week.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Enterprise Sales

Markus —

Quick follow from our exec review: they liked Option B for regional 99.99 but want three changes before legal signs off: 

1) S1 response must be 15 minutes (not an add-on). Our product roadmap is latency-sensitive and we need guaranteed triage within 15 minutes.
2) Credit formula should be simplified and capped at 50% of monthly invoice for the add-on (no unlimited exposure).
3) We request a short mitigation SLA: if an incident exceeds 6 hours without mitigation, an additional credit is applied.

If Redwood can accept those terms we can fast-track to DocuSign this week. If any of this requires executive review on your side, please flag what needs approval — pricing uplift, oncall commitments, or the credit cap.

Thanks,
Emma

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear feedback and the fast timeline. I pulled in engineering and ops to confirm feasibility and here is a consolidated counter that is intended to be finalable without an exec escalation: 

- Uptime: we will commit to 99.99% regional uptime for your primary region (us-west) as requested.
- S1 response: we can make 15-minute initial response a committed term, with the following note on mitigation: we define "initial response" as acknowledgement and triage start; full mitigation SLAs vary by incident class.
- Mitigation window: we will add a mitigation milestone credit if an incident is not mitigated within 8 hours (compromise from your 6 hours). That credit is separate from the uptime credit.
- Credit cap: we will adopt a 50% monthly cap on total credits for the add-on.

Commercials to accept these commitments: 
- Option B (99.99) base: $14,900/mo
- S1 15-min guaranteed response: +18% uplift on Option B ($17,582/mo)
- Annual prepay discount: 10% off the annualized commitment if you sign by Dec 15, 2026.
- Early-sign onboarding credit: 10% one-time credit applied to month 1 for annual signers.

We attached a redline (SLA_Redline_Emma_v1.docx) that records the exact clause language for the SLA and credit cap. If that redline looks good to legal, we can generate a final quote and send a DocuSign envelope.

If you prefer a monthly pilot first, we can offer the same terms but billed monthly without the annual discount. Please let us know which route you prefer; we're available for a 30-min bridge with your SREs tomorrow morning PST.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
